title: Ukukhishwa kwe-Kyber 0.29
author: Jean-Baptiste Kempf
quote: I-Kyber 0.29 yenza ukulawula ngesikhathi sangempela kube lula ukukusebenzisa, kucace kakhudlwana ukukubona, futhi kulungele izindawo eziningi.
html:
I-Kyber 0.29: ukufinyelela okwengeziwe, ukwethembeka okwengeziwe, ukulawula okwengeziwe

I-Kyber 0.29 yenza ukulawula ngesikhathi sangempela kube lula ukukusebenzisa, kucace kakhudlwana ukukubona, futhi kulungele izindawo eziningi. Ukusekelwa kwe-WebSocket okwakhelwe ngaphakathi kunweba ukufinyelela kumanethiwekhi ezinkampani, ukufaka ikhodi ngo-4:4:4 kugcina imininingwane ebonakalayo ekucaceni kwasekuqaleni kwesikrini, kanti amakhono amasha okuthwebula ezinhlelweni ezishumekiwe avula indlela ye-Raspberry Pi kanye nokusetshenziswa emaphethelweni enethiwekhi. Iphinde yethule izisekelo zokuqala zokuphatha amaqoqo amakhulu emishini ye-Kyber.

Nakhu ukuthi lokho kusho ukuthini empilweni yangempela.

Ukufinyelela okwengeziwe: i-Kyber manje isebenza kumanethiwekhi ayeyivimba

Lapho inethiwekhi ithi cha

Ngokuzenzakalelayo, i-Kyber ixhuma nge-QUIC, iphrothokholi yesimanje yenethiwekhi eyakhelwe isivinini. Ingesinye sezizathu ezenza i-Kyber izwakale isheshe ngokumangalisayo. Inkinga ukuthi amanye amanethiwekhi ezinkampani ayayivimba i-QUIC, noma awayamukeli nhlobo. Kumsebenzisi ozama ukufinyelela emshinini ongemuva kwe-firewall eqinile, lokho bekusho ukuthi akukho nokuxhuma nhlobo.

I-Kyber ithola enye indlela nge-WebSocket

I-Kyber 0.29 yengeza indlela ephelele yokuphepha esebenzisa i-WebSocket, izinga elamukelwa cishe yiyo yonke inethiwekhi. Uma i-QUIC ivinjiwe, i-Kyber ishintshela ku-WebSocket bese ukuxhuma kuyaphumelela. Kuhamba kancane kancane, kodwa uhlala uxhunyiwe. Indlela yakho yokulawula ihlala itholakala, noma ngabe imigomo ye-IT ithini.

Ukusekelwa kwe-WebSocket manje sekwakhelwe ngaphakathi kuklayenti le-Kyber lekhompyutha. Ngaphakathi, izinguqulo zesiphequluli nezekhompyutha zisebenzisa ikhodi efanayo yokuxhuma, ngakho konke ukuthuthukiswa kufika kuzo zombili ngesikhathi esisodwa.

Ukwethembeka okwengeziwe: yonke iphikseli, wonke umbala, kunoma imuphi umshini

Kungani izikrini zekude zivame ukufiphala

Ukuze konge umkhawulokudonsa, ukusakazwa kwamavidiyo amaningi kugcina umbala ngokucaca okuphansi kunokukhanya. Efilimini, akekho obonayo. Esikrinini somsebenzi, wonke umuntu uyabona: amaseli amancane e-spreadsheet aba nzima ukuwafunda, imibala yomkhiqizo iyaguquka, nemigqa emincane kumamodeli e-3D iyahlangana.

Umbala ophelele we-4:4:4 ekucaceni kwasekuqaleni kwesikrini sakho

I-Kyber 0.29 ifaka ikhodi ngombala ophelele we-4:4:4, okusho ukuthi yonke iphikseli igcina umbala wayo ngqo. Umbhalo uhlala ucacile, izixhumi-mbono zihlala zibukhali futhi imibala ihlala inembile, ngisho nasemishinini enehadiwe yezithombe engakwazi ukufaka ikhodi ye-4:4:4 iyodwa.

I-Kyber futhi ayisazinciphisi izikrini ezinkulu. Kuze kube manje, ukufaka ikhodi ngesofthiwe bekunciphisa noma yini ebanzi kunamaphikseli angu-1920 kube yi-Full HD. Lowo mkhawulo awusekho. Ideskithophu ye-4K manje isakazwa ngo-4K.

I-Excel yakho ihlala ifundeka, noma ngabe isebenza kuphi.

Izinkundla ezengeziwe: ukulawula ngesikhathi sangempela, ngisho naku-Raspberry Pi

Iseva ye-Kyber manje ingathwebula izithombe nge-GStreamer, ithuluzi elivamile lomsindo nevidiyo kumadivayisi amaningi ashumekiwe. Lokhu kukhishwa kuphinde kulethe ukukhetha ihadiwe ngobuhlakani obukhulu, ukuphatha kangcono ozimele, nokwehla kwesikhathi sokufaka ikhodi, kanye nokulungiswa kokuphahlazeka kumakhadi ezithombe e-Intel Arc.

Uma zihlangene, lezi zinguquko zisivumela ukuthi silungise i-Kyber ngokunembile ku-Raspberry Pi nakwamanye amadivayisi amancane asebenzisa amandla amancane. Lokho kubalulekile kwezamarobhothi, amadrowni, nakuwo wonke amadivayisi asemaphethelweni lapho ukusakaza kwe-Kyber okunokubambezeleka okuphansi kufanele kusebenze kuhadiwe enamandla alinganiselwe. Iphakheji ekhethekile ye-Raspberry Pi isizofika maduze ku-GitLab.

Ukulawula okwengeziwe: izisekelo zokuphatha amaqoqo amakhulu emishini ye-Kyber

Kusendleleni iphothali yokuphatha, ezovumela amaqembu ukuthi abone futhi alawule yonke imishini ye-Kyber endaweni eyodwa. I-Kyber 0.29 ibeka isisekelo.

Ukushaya kwenhliziyo kuwo wonke umshini

I-ejenti entsha ivumela umsingathi ngamunye we-Kyber ukuthi athumele isignali encane cishe njalo emizuzwaneni eyi-10 ukusho ukuthi uxhunyiwe futhi ulungile. Uma isignali ima, uyazi ukuthi umshini awutholakali. Akukho ukuqagela, akukho ukuhlola ngesandla.

Izikhathi zokusebenza ezihlala zingenile

Ukuxhuma okuqinisekisiwe manje kuthola ukushintshaniswa nokuvuselelwa kwamathokheni ngokuzenzakalelayo. Ithokheni isebenza njengemvume yedijithali yesikhashana. I-Kyber manje iyivuselela ngemuva, ngakho izikhathi zokusebenza ezivikelekile zihlala zivuliwe ngaphandle kokucela abasebenzisi ukuthi bangene futhi.

Ukufinyelela ngokuchofoza kanye ngezixhumanisi ze-kyber://

I-Kyber manje inefomethi yayo yezixhumanisi. Chofoza isixhumanisi se-kyber:// esipheqululini, ku-imeyili noma kudeshibhodi, bese iklayenti lekhompyutha livuleka ngqo emshinini ofanele.

Kulula ukufaka ku-macOS

Iseva ye-Kyber ye-macOS manje ifika njengephakheji ephelele. Kulula ukuyifaka futhi kulula ukuyisabalalisa eqoqweni lama-Mac. Okulandelayo: iphakheji esebenza ngokugcwele nesayiniwe, i-macOS ezoyethemba ngokushesha.

Okunye ukuthuthukiswa nokulungiswa

  • Umsindo: i-codec yomsindo i-Opus yenyukela kunguqulo 1.6.1.
  • Ukuphepha: i-OIDC, izinga elisekela ukungena kanye kuphela, manje isekela ukuqinisekiswa kwezethameli okuzikhethela. I-Kyber ingahlola ukuthi ithokheni yokungena ikhishelwe i-Kyber hhayi olunye uhlelo lokusebenza.
  • Izitifiketi: i-Kyber manje ihlola ukuxhuma okuvikelekile iqhathanisa nohlu lwesistimu yakho yokusebenza lwezitifiketi ezethembekile.
  • Iklayenti lewebhu: ukukhiya isikhombi manje kusebenza kahle emidlalweni efihla isikhombi.
  • VLC: isici se-Video buffer manje sisebenza ne-VideoToolbox, isihumushi sevidiyo sehadiwe se-Apple.
  • Ukwethembeka: ukuphuma okuhlanzekile uma singekho isibonisi, ukuvalwa okusheshayo kwezikhathi zokusebenza, ukulungiswa kokwakha nge-GCC 16, kanye namalogi athule kakhulu.

Thola i-Kyber 0.29

I-Kyber 0.29 isitholakala manje. Konke okudingayo ukuze uqale kutholakala lapha.
